configurations.name: kalendr-e2e-3100
runtimeArgs: node e2e/support/capture-server.mjs & set -a; source .e2e/runtime.env; set +a; export NODE_ENV=production BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3100 BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100 BETTER_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true KALENDR_ALLOW_CLINIC_REGISTRATION=true KALENDR_PREVIEW_MODE=false KALENDR_FILE_STORE_DIR=.e2e/files EMAIL_FROM=tests@example.com RESEND_API_KEY=e2e-capture-only EMAIL_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3199/emails SENTRY_DSN=http://e2epublickey@127.0.0.1:3199/1 SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=e2e; exec pnpm exec next start --port 3100

configurations.name: kalendr-admin-ui-3130
runtimeArgs: while IFS= read -r line; do [[ "$line" == *=* ]] && export "$line"; done < .e2e-adminui/runtime.env; export NODE_ENV=production BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:3130 BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3130 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3130 BETTER_AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION=true KALENDR_PREVIEW_MODE=false KALENDR_FILE_STORE_DIR=.e2e-adminui/files TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1 EMAIL_FROM=tests@example.com RESEND_API_KEY=e2e-capture-only EMAIL_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3299/emails; exec pnpm exec next start --port 3130
